_comment: The two-host pool: the laptop (hostname fedora) is the harness host on .1 and also runs the GTX 1650 Ti node; the RTX 4070 box boots from the Crucial X9 as hostname rtx4070 on .11. The addresses match the 10.42.0.0/24 subnet that tools/lan-up.sh and tools/pool-install.sh both assume. client_endpoint is the port the replay client binds for F-11 deliveries; it must be reachable INBOUND from every worker host, which is the check nothing else performs. Both nodes run the 1B model because F-9 holds engine, model and quant constant across pool members.
